messages:
Priya (CEO): Quick Q&A follow-up from today's all-hands on sales pipeline, GTM priorities, and partnerships. I'll capture actions here. Keep replies short.
Tara - VP Sales: Pipeline snapshot: ARR coverage ~3.1x, demo->PO ~7.8%. Two top deals in legal. Question: pilot pricing for partner?
Maya (Finance): Recommend pilot discount = 12% time-limited. Keeps accounting simple and avoids large comp resets.
Liam (Partnerships): Partner wants SAML SSO + a basic webhook for user provisioning. Also asked for co-branded collateral and a short case-study approval SLA.
Ana (PM, Product): Eng estimate for SAML + webhook spike: 2 devs for 8 working days + 1 QA for 4 days. Tag ticket `partner-pilot-q1`.
Rachel (Ops): If partner chooses Dedicated we need a one-off onboarding checklist and a temporary SLA. I'll draft and post the checklist.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Growth needs partner attribution params on signup URLs. Can we add UTM + partner_id?
Ana (PM, Product): Yes, add `partner_id` + `utm_medium=partner` to event schema. I'll include in the spike ticket.
Tara - VP Sales: Discount guardrail: AE approval up to 12%. Anything above 12% requires RevOps + Sales exec OK. We'll document in playbook.
Priya (CEO): Actions: 1) Eng spike for SAML/webhook (Ana). 2) Rachel drafts Dedicated runbook + SLA. 3) Liam to produce 1-pager on co-sell vs referral flows. 4) RevOps/Tara finalize discount bands. Follow-up sync on Wed 9am PT (calendar invite sent).
Liam (Partnerships): I'll DM partner name per NDA.
Maya (Finance): I'll write the short pilot billing note for accounting.
Tara - VP Sales: If anyone has a blocker on the 8-day estimate, ping me directly.
Priya (CEO): Thanks all :thumbsup: Add any leftover items to the calendar invite or the shared doc.
